_comment: Cards that exist only for the graveyard-cast-permission test (tests/unit/casting/test_cast_from_graveyard.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_machinist` is Edgar's shape: once per turn you may cast an artifact spell from your graveyard, and it enters tapped. `t_untapped_machinist` is the same permission without the rider.

cards.name: Test Machinist
cards.oracle_text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an artifact spell from your graveyard. If you cast a spell this way, that artifact enters tapped.

abilities.text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an artifact spell from your graveyard. If you cast a spell this way, that artifact enters tapped.

cards.name: Test Untapped Machinist
cards.oracle_text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an artifact spell from your graveyard.

abilities.text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an artifact spell from your graveyard.

cards.name: Test Pray
cards.oracle_text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature spell from among cards in your graveyard that were put there from anywhere other than the battlefield this turn.

abilities.text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature spell from among cards in your graveyard that were put there from anywhere other than the battlefield this turn.
